device.model: Mini Combo Extra (System ID 24000A00, firmware 1.0.35 emu)
device.type: DVB-S2 + DVB-T2/C Full HD H.265/HEVC combo satellite, terrestrial and cable receiver with Conax / MultiCAS card reader, Ethernet and USB
device.soc: ALi M3526A / C3505 (256 MB DDR3 dual-CPU H.265/HEVC combo SoC reading chip ID 0x3505; NIM_C3505_0, NIM_COFDM_0, NIM_QAM_S3202, DMX_S3601_0/2, DECV_HEVC_0, DECV_AVC_0, DECV_AVS_0, DECV_S3601_0, OSD_DEV_0/1/2, seecode "M3606 SEE" at 0xAE000200)
device.demod: internal ALi C3505 DVB-S2 (NIM_C3505_0) + DVB-T2/C front end (NIM_COFDM_0 / NIM_QAM_S3202)
device.tuner: Airoha AV2018 / ALi M3031 (DVB-S2) + Rafael Micro R836 (DVB-T2/C) drivers compiled in

image.layout: bootloader 0x000000 (3526A 1.1.1, 2016-08-12, boot-ROM script at 0x480 + code at 0x800 in 0x9FE00800), maincode(AV) 0x02F000 (24000A001035, LZMA -> 11.89 MB at 0x80000200), seecode 0x3A0000 (M3606 SEE, LZMA -> 0xAE000200), default_lang 0x4AFD00, cipluskey 0x4AFF80, countryband 0x4C0000, logo_user 0x4C8000, logo_menu 0x4D8000, logo_radio 0x4F8000, logo_boot 0x518000, patch 0x53FF80, defaultdb(PRC) 0x560000, userdb(64+64) 0x73FF80

source.author: Amiko
source.note: Archive AMIKO_Mini_Combo_Extra_1.0.35_emu.zip from the Amiko / Amiko HD directory on satedu.cba.pl; fetched 2026-11-02.

simulator.note: Boots as a 256 MB C3505 board (chips/c3505.py, run_dump_mini_combo_extra_1035_app_starts.py, run_dump_mini_combo_extra_1035_capture_screen.py): the boot-ROM bootloader runs at 0x9FE00800, sets 0xB8000220 bit 24 to remap physical 0x0F000000..0x0FFFFFFF to the top 16 MB of DDR, writes " ON " to the CH455 panel on GPIO 107 / 110, unpacks seecode ("M3606 SEE") to 0xAE000200 and maincode(AV) ("24000A001035") to 0x80000200, and starts both cores (main EBase 0x80002000, SEE EBase 0x8E002001).  The application updates the CH455 panel to " on ", probes the RF front-end sharing GPIO 107 / 110, populates userdb(64+64) from defaultdb(PRC) over SPI, and renders its OSD dialog on the Full HD 1920x1080 CLUT8 G1 layer at 0xB8006A00.

desc: Amiko Mini Combo Extra (System ID 24000A00) EMU firmware v1.0.35 for the compact Full HD H.265/HEVC DVB-S2 + DVB-T2/C combo receiver on the ALi M3526A / C3505 SoC with 256 MB DDR3 and 8 MB SPI flash.
Uses the 256 MB DDR remap (0xB8000220 bit 24, SEE at 0xAE000200), a CH455 4-digit LED panel on GPIO 107 (SCL) / 110 (SDA), and the display engine's Full HD 1920x1080 CLUT8 G1 OSD layer at 0xB8006A00.
